<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD uses a single source URL (`https://stavekontrolden.dk/dictionaries/da_DK/da_DK-$pkgver.oxt`) from the package’s own official domain. All top‑level definitions are static; there is no `pkgver()` function, no code in global scope that performs network requests, command substitution, or downloads. The only file extraction (`bsdtar -xf …`) is inside the `package()` function, which is not executed with `--nobuild --noprepare`. Thus sourcing the PKGBUILD and fetching the source does not trigger any malicious or suspicious actions.

- Source is standard HTTPs from the declared project URL.
- No dynamic evaluation, eval, curl, wget, or base64 decoding appears in global scope.
- All variables are simple literals; `${provides[@]}` expansion is safe.
- No `prepare()`, `build()`, or `package()` code runs during the audit commands.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>Source fetch is from official domain, no code executed in global scope.</summary>
